name: Galahaut

attributes.attribute: was an Arthurian hero known as the Haute Prince
was Arthur's enemy until Lancelot defeated him
died of grief when he heard that Lancelot had died

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Galahaut was an Arthurian hero. Sources call him the Haute Prince. He was a minor figure in the story of King Arthur and the Round Table. At first Galahaut was Arthur's enemy. The knight Lancelot defeated him. He then converted to the side of Camelot. He was devoted to Lancelot. He died of grief when he heard that Lancelot had died.

okr.objective: Record Galahaut as an Arthurian hero and follower of Lancelot.
key_results: Introduce Galahaut as a minor figure in Arthurian legend.
Relate his defeat by Lancelot and his conversion to Camelot.
Describe his death of grief over Lancelot.
